scripts.build: tsc -b && vite build && vite build --ssr src/entry-server.tsx --outDir dist-ssr && node scripts/prerender.mjs
scripts.build:qa: tsc -b && vite build --mode qa && vite build --ssr src/entry-server.tsx --outDir dist-ssr --mode qa && node scripts/prerender.mjs
scripts.build:prod: tsc -b && vite build --mode production && vite build --ssr src/entry-server.tsx --outDir dist-ssr --mode production && node scripts/prerender.mjs
scripts.check:static: npm run deps:check && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run parity:check
scripts.test:contracts: vitest run scripts/api-contracts.test.ts scripts/fetch-api-contracts.test.ts scripts/parity-matrix.test.ts src/api/*.test.ts --exclude='src/api/client.test.ts'
scripts.test:integration: vitest run scripts/auth-e2e-upstream.test.ts src/api/client.test.ts src/auth/AuthContext.test.tsx src/cabinet/tenant-transition.test.ts
scripts.verify:quality: npm run verify:quality:nonbrowser && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:smoke
scripts.verify:release:prod: npm run build:prod && npm run check:artifact:prod && npm run budget:assets && npm run audit:lhci && wrangler deploy --dry-run --env production
scripts.verify:release:qa: npm run build:qa && npm run check:artifact:qa && npm run budget:assets && wrangler deploy --dry-run --env qa
scripts.deploy:qa: npm run check && npm run build:qa && npm run check:artifact:qa && npm run budget:assets && wrangler deploy --dry-run --env qa && wrangler deploy --env qa
scripts.check: npm run check:static && npm run test:unit && npm run test:contracts && npm run test:integration
